was a map themed around a skatepark. It was the event map for

. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on the difficulty chosen. It had no unique rewards other than currency for

You only got cash if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down.
All difficulties have health scaling of 20% in quad matches, but due to matches always being quad matches this is always applied. Starting from Master difficulty,
is applied, which increases the health of an enemy by 10% every wave after its first appearance. In the Extreme difficulty,
is also applied, which jails a random tower type every wave starting from Wave 6. These modifiers will boost the rewards gained for Master and Extreme difficulty by 20%.

was a daytime map inside a skatepark. The entire skatepark was surrounded by various colorful buildings and walls. The skatepark itself contained a few small buildings, stairs, fences, walls, skateboards, lamps and obstacles. Graffiti could be seen on the sides of buildings, which had multiple depictions of Roblox or Tower Defense Simulator characters.
The path starts and ends at a black entrance inside the buildings. It consists of several 90 degree turns, with multiple grey arrows showing which direction the enemies are going in.

Each difficulty allowed the player to pick from one of three preset loadouts. Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option will be unavailable.

If you are using your own loadout, you can also bring the
in higher difficulties as they have more waves allowing you to farm more.
is added which will lock a tower type per player every wave starting from Wave 6.
It is therefore heavily advised to place down multiple different towers instead of spending money on only one tower.
It is possible to partially mitigate this by using mostly towers that bypass the jail effect in some form, such as
does lose its ability to grant buffs when jailed, no other tower has this. This means support towers can be used mostly without issues.
